symptom: Customers report that checkout orders are not completing as expected

report.summary: Incident window shows 6 orders stuck in PAYMENT_PENDING with PAYMENT_UNAVAILABLE events. order-service-to-payment-service POST /payments shows 6 client HttpTimeoutException (D18), while payment-service received 12 requests, all 201 (D19), and its /payments latency max rose to 8.58s (D27). Gateway-mock /authorize max rose to 8.57s (D33) with no errors. Slowness starts at gateway-mock; payment-service waits on it, order-service times out. No restarts or errors in any service.

evidence.why: order-service->payment-service client calls timed out (HttpTimeoutException) 6 times in incident window
gateway-mock /authorize latency max rose to 8.573s in incident window with no errors
payment-service /payments latency max rose to 8.582s, waiting on gateway-mock
gateway-mock logged no warnings or errors, so it answers slowly rather than failing
